apps/console/src/data/mutations.test.ts::guards per key, never per method: t1 and t2 both run
apps/console/src/data/mutations.test.ts::guards only while in flight: the same call after it settles is sent again
apps/console/src/data/mutations.test.ts::keeps a failure nobody was mounted to read, until it is acknowledged
apps/console/src/data/mutations.test.ts::keeps the newest 32 settled outcomes and never evicts a call in flight

deviations_from_card: (1) Case 7 lives in a new coupled test apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/inflight.test.tsx, not react.test.tsx: eslint boundaries forbid data/ importing kit/ or pages/. (2) Commit split: commit 1 = data layer + NoReport (case 7 needs it) + budget; commit 2 = ChatPage, PlanPage, ClipActions. (3) Pages show a missed failure (settled.error) until the operator's next run/seal/render, which acks it, rather than ack-on-read in an effect (react-hooks set-state-in-effect lint). The hook-level contract (unacked until ack(); a second reader sees none after ack) is as carded and tested. (4) Caller claims: an outcome settles already-acknowledged when a mounted caller still awaits it, so the starter never sees its own error twice. (5) ChatPage does not read settled: its orphaned call still writes reply/failure into the module session store, so nothing is lost there. (6) apps/console/budgets/bundle.json entry js 291,500 -> 294,500 under the lock (measured 291,724 -> 294,162 B, +2,438 B: MutationStore + hooks ride the first load with the data layer, which the layer composes at boot).
notes: Critic note honoured: the report still opened after a remount at HEAD (the orphaned closure calls session.showReport); the card's claim is about pending/disabled state and lost errors, which is what the tests pin. A second click/submit while a run is in flight sends no second reconcile.run (pinned in case 7 with both click and form submit). Limit stated in code and commit: client-only, the daemon has no reconcile.run guard, so two console tabs are not protected. NoReport edit kept to the busy/inflight/missed-error lines.
